findings.evidence: has_link_or_contact() is False and surface.clean() leaves the text unchanged for: 'refundsportal.Cash', 'refundsportal.Lol', 'refundsportal.CaSh', 'Refundsportal.Exchange', 'Refundsportal.Deals' (all real registrable gTLDs). With the source 'Claim your energy rebate refund at Refundsportal.Cash before the deadline.': extractive() picks the sentence; verify('... at Refundsportal.Cash before the deadline [1].', [src]) keeps it with dropped=[]; build_surface() output contains 'Refundsportal.Cash'. _is_domain only accepts an ASCII TLD that is all-lower, all-upper, on the ~200-entry _TLDS list, followed by '/', or on a host with a hyphen or digit. Also not detected: 'refundsportal [.] com', 'refundsportal dot com', and phone numbers ('1800 555 0199').
findings.suggested_fix: Do not decide a host by a TLD allow-list: treat any label.label form with an alphabetic TLD of 2+ letters as a link unless the first letter after the dot is upper case AND the preceding character ends a sentence-like token with no other host signals (or use the full IANA TLD list, case-insensitive). Add spaced-defang forms and phone-number contacts, with regression cases.

findings.evidence: states_quantity() is False for 'doubling', 'halving', 'tripling', 'quintupled', 'sextupled', 'biweekly', 'bimonthly', 'semiannual', 'triennial', 'multiplied', '‰', 'pct', 'ppm'. verify('Rents in the capital are doubling under the new rules [1].', ['Rents in the capital are nearly doubling under the new rules.']) keeps the claim unquoted (quoted=False). It is the same for 'possibly halving' -> 'halving', 'almost quintupled' -> 'quintupled', 'barely sextupled' -> 'sextupled' and 'roughly biweekly' -> 'biweekly'. The gap rule (MAX_GAP_WORDS=2) allows skipping the qualifier because the skipped word is not a quantity.
findings.suggested_fix: Make D7 not depend on the word list: either allow no skipped content word at all (claim = contiguous run of source tokens apart from function words), or quote whenever any source word is skipped; add the listed forms and -ing/-ed forms of multiplicatives to _QUANTITY as the secondary check.
findings.title: R2-02 repair incomplete: _excerpt lets a claim drop a qualifier next to an undetected quantity word (doubling, halving, quintupled, biweekly), so a changed quantity is shown in the Brain's words
